7399-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
7399-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

69-539-3172-7014.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-3172-7014.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-3172-7014.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

3025-4279-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3025-4279-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1174-1671-1912-3869.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least one mana.
1174-1671-1912-3869.description:
Activate another land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and returning the land tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by paying {G}{U} due to Biomancer's Familiar, causing you to draw a card and put the land returned to hand in step 2 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

5147-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5147-5254-6627.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

147-3085-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-5686.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-2907-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-2907-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

339-677-728-1322.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3951-5703-5744-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-5703-5744-8095.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

4-1170-1636-7529.description:
Cast Rampant Growth using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year.
When Studious First-Year enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-7824.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Wizard Class triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

2279-2511-3240-6462.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3605-4812-5256-5987.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-5231-6719-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6719-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2178-2438-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

661-2604-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {1} due to Ugin, the Ineffable. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2539-3094-4659-4885-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-4885-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2146-4871-5795-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Cloud Key.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2557-3488-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Katsumasa.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

821-5220-6094-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1402-2218-3480-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3197-4321-6824-6890.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4321-6824-6890.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1315-3875-5721-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp.
1315-3875-5721-6883.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tireless Provisioner triggers that many times, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}{G}.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

431-851-2557-3129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-2557-3129.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

560-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee, the Soldier and the Alien Warrior, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

539-2292-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1168-1651-1863-5334-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-1863-5334-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-1863-5334-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1379-3003-4231-5966-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control enough artifacts to reduce Rory Williams's command tax to 0.
1379-3003-4231-5966-6441.description:
Cast Rory Williams by paying {W}{U}.
Rory Williams's last ability triggers, exiling it and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Rory Williams to the command zone from exile.
Sacrifice the two Treasure tokens for {W}{U}.
Repeat.

851-3129-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
851-3129-5658-6245.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
851-3129-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

1741-2404-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1741-2404-5900.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Gaea's Cradle and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.
1741-2404-5900.notes: If you control three or more creatures, this combo nets infinite green mana, and you may instead untap any other land(s) in place of Gaea's Cradle

147-3645-4050.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1988-5641.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Basking Broodscale.
1988-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2511-5370-5434.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Master of the Veil.
When Master of the Veil dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Master of the Veil from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Master of the Veil triggers, turning itself face down.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3175-3908-4349.notablePrerequisites:
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
You have the highest life total.
670-1619-3175-3908-4349.description:
Cast Sun Titan by paying {4}{W}{W}.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it, Radiant Solar and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Fell Stinger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fell Stinger enters the battlefield, its exploit ability, Radiant Solar and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Fell Stinger trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Fell Stinger's second ability triggers, causing target player to draw 2 cards and lose 2 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Trapped Entry" room of Tomb of Annihilation, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Veils of Fear" room, causing each player to discard a card or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Sandfall Cell" room, causing you to sacrifice Sun Titan and each opponent to either sacrifice a creature, artifact or land, or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Cradle of the Death God" room, creating a legendary 4/4 The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

618-859-2741-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-859-2741-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

2034-4365-4716-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prosperous Innkeeper, adding {C}{C}.
When Prosperous Innkeeper dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Prosperous Innkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

224-1257-1373-2653-4482.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1257-1373-2653-4482.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Nissa and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve both Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Walking Atlas and choosing either to untap another creature or scry 1.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, giving a creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

487-2723.notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel attached to Sporeweb Weaver.
You have a way to give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
487-2723.description:
Give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
Sporeweb Weaver and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Sporeweb Weaver trigger, creating a 1/1 green Saproling creature token and gaining you 1 life.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing at least one damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
Repeat from step 3.

640-2034-4875-5170.notablePrerequisites: Any creature type besides "Dragon" chosen with Conspiracy.
640-2034-4875-5170.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji, adding {C}{C}.
Junji dies, triggering itself and Dross Harvester.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

1952-2792-4730.notablePrerequisites:
Livio does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
1952-2792-4730.description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Livio's first ability twice by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Great Whale and Sparring Mummy with aegis counters on them.
Activate Livio's second ability by paying {2}{W} and tapping it, returning Great Whale and Sparring Mummy from exile to the battlefield.
Sparring Mummy and Great Whale enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Sparring Mummy trigger, untapping Livio.
Repeat.

618-908-5056.description:
Pay {U} to Neurok Transmuter to make Kiki-Jiki into an artifact.
Pat {U} to Neurok Transmuter to make Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

617-4235-4563.notablePrerequisites: Everflowing Chalice has 4 or more charge counters on it.
617-4235-4563.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice to add {C}{C}{C}{C} to your mana pool.
Activate Voltaic Key to untap Everflowing Chalice.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers allowing you to copy Voltaic Key's ability and untap Voltaic key with the copy.
Repeat.
